name: National Gas and Industrialization Company
summary: National Gas and Industrialization Company engages in exploits, manufactures, and markets various kinds of gas and its derivatives, and industrial gases in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It manufactures, sells, and maintains cages, cylinders, tanks, and accessories; maintenance of gas networks and accessories; and manufactures, transports, and markets petroleum, chemical, and petrochemical and glass products. The company also establishes or participates in the production of energy, water treatment, and environmental services.
